page.overview:
What is The Bite of '83?

The Big Bite, later known as The Bite of '83 after The Bite of '87 happened, was an incident at Fredbear's Family Diner in 1983 in which the Crying Child was placed in the jaws of Fredbear, resulting in him being fatally injured. The events are shown in the end-of-night minigames of FNaF 4.

The main protagonist of the minigame, a crying child who is being thrown a party at Fredbear's Family Diner, is harshly tormented by several older kids, including his older brother who targeted his greatest fear, knowing the child's intense fear of the Springlock Animatronics. The bullies forcefully carried the child closer to the animatronics, but their actions escalate as the child's intense panic takes hold. This results in the child's head being shoved entirely into Fredbear's mouth, mockingly labeling it as a "big kiss". Amidst squirming and loud wails of terror, the animatronic's mouth then eventually crushes the victim's head, fatally injuring him as the bullies stop laughing, only staring in horror and shock.

An arcade game named "Fredbear's Nom Nom Bits" appears in the Pizzaplex, a clear reference to the bite.

Calling the phone number found on the Fredbear's Family Diner poster reveals that the company has created a pizza based on the event: The Golden Bite, with 83 slices of cheese smothered in a molten layer of Exotic Butters.
